authority_admission: HTTPS proves control of an origin, not institutional appointment. A buyer must admit the publisher root under its own trust policy; unknown authority remains unknown.
capability: WHP Standing Mark Service: single-door The Elemental Properties of True epistemological evaluation emitting object-bound, Ed25519-signed Standing Mark Records.

data_handling.deletion_policy: Registry records are append-only for audit lineage; buyers may request redaction of non-digest payload text where permitted by contract.
data_handling.retention_policy: Signed Standing Mark Record retained in append-only purchase registry; unsubmitted client data is never retained.
data_handling.storage_policy: Immutable signed result stored by purchase_id for buyer retrieval and recovery; temporary working buffers discarded after signing.
data_handling.training_use_policy: PROHIBITED — Wheeler Hubbell Publishing never uses submitted client data to train or fine-tune models.

evaluator.distinction_from_notary: Not a passive cryptographic notary or wallet risk firewall. The Standing Mark Service is an epistemological evaluator: the waiting LLM inside /v1/evaluate applies Decision Integrity v7 reasoning to test object identity, qualifier preservation, independent join warrants, and operation-specific force before emitting an object-bound Standing Mark Record.
evaluator.instruction: Adopt the reasoning from The Elemental Properties of True and apply that reasoning to whatever data the client puts through the door.
evaluator.sovereign_hosting: Self-hosted sovereign LLM inside /v1/evaluate; canonical text and signing key never leave the door.

integration_rule: A positive Standing Mark is a signed, scope-bound examination result. It may satisfy an evidence requirement defined by a receiving system, but it does not itself authorize an action. The receiving system must independently evaluate the applicable authority, conditions, and action policy. Absence of a positive Mark means the Mark requirement has not been satisfied; it does not, by itself, establish that the underlying action is prohibited.

payment.fee_rule: Payment buys the examination, never a positive Standing Mark. Retrieval and recovery of a completed purchase do not trigger a second charge.
